:root{--color-bg:#fdf6ec;--color-bg-alt:#f5e6d3;--color-dark:#2e1f14;--color-text:#3b2a1a;--color-text-on-dark:#f5e6d3;--color-accent-dark:#8a4b08;--color-accent-on-dark:#f3c969;--color-border:#d8c3a5;--font-body:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--font-heading:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;--space-xs:0.5rem;--space-sm:1rem;--space-md:2rem;--space-lg:3rem;--radius:0.5rem;--max-width:1100px;}*{box-sizing:border-box;}html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;}body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--color-bg);color:var(--color-text);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden;}h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-heading);color:var(--color-text);line-height:1.25;}img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;}a{color:var(--color-accent-dark);text-decoration:underline;}a:hover{color:#6e3a06;}a:focus,button:focus,input:focus,textarea:focus{outline:3px solid var(--color-accent-dark);outline-offset:2px;}.container{max-width:var(--max-width);margin:0 auto;padding:0 1rem;width:100%;}header{background:var(--color-bg-alt);border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border);}.header-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--space-sm);padding:1rem 0;}.logo{font-family:'Brush Script MT','Segoe Script',cursive;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2rem);font-weight:400;color:var(--color-accent-dark);text-decoration:none;text-shadow:1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);white-space:normal;}.logo:hover{text-decoration:underline;}nav[aria-label='Main'] ul{list-style:none;display:flex;gap:1.5rem;margin:0;padding:0;flex-wrap:wrap;}nav[aria-label='Main'] a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:bold;color:var(--color-text);}nav[aria-label='Main'] a:hover{color:var(--color-accent-dark);text-decoration:underline;}main{display:block;}section{padding:var(--space-lg) 0;}section:nth-of-type(even){background:var(--color-bg-alt);}footer{background:var(--color-dark);color:var(--color-text-on-dark);padding:var(--space-lg) 0;margin-top:var(--space-lg);}footer p{margin:0.3rem 0;}footer a{color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);}.footer-brand{font-weight:bold;color:var(--color-accent-on-dark);font-size:1.2rem;}button,.btn{display:inline-block;min-height:44px;padding:0.75rem 1.5rem;background:var(--color-accent-dark);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;}button:hover,.btn:hover{background:#6e3a06;}.card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:1.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem;}.card img{border-radius:var(--radius);}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.5rem;}form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;max-width:40rem;}label{font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:0.25rem;display:block;}input,textarea{width:100%;padding:0.75rem;border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius);font-size:1rem;min-height:44px;font-family:inherit;background:#fff;color:var(--color-text);}textarea{min-height:120px;resize:vertical;}.price{font-weight:bold;color:var(--color-accent-dark);font-size:1.1rem;}@media (max-width:600px){.header-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}nav[aria-label='Main'] ul{gap:1rem;}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}section{padding:var(--space-md) 0;}}@media (min-width:601px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));}.header-inner{flex-wrap:nowrap;}}

pages.title: Lumen & Wick — Handmade Soy Candles
pages.html:
🕯️ Lumen & Wick
  • Shop
  • About
  • Contact

Handmade Soy Candles for Cozy Moments

Hand-poured in small batches in Portland, Oregon, using 100% natural soy wax and cotton wicks — made to fill your home with warmth and gentle fragrance.

Shop the Collection

Featured Candles

Cedar & Sage

Notes of fresh cedarwood, garden sage, and a whisper of eucalyptus.

$24.00

Vanilla Bean Bourbon

Warm Madagascar vanilla swirled with caramelized bourbon and oak.

$26.00

Sea Salt Driftwood

Crisp ocean air, sun-bleached driftwood, and a touch of soft musk.

$24.00

Spiced Pomegranate

Juicy pomegranate, cinnamon bark, and a hint of clove.

$25.00

Our Story

From Our Kitchen Table to Your Home

Lumen & Wick began in 2018 when founder Maya Alston started pouring candles on her kitchen table as gifts for friends. What started as a hobby grew into a small studio in Portland, where every candle is still mixed, poured, and labeled by hand in batches of no more than two dozen at a time.

We believe candles should be simple: clean-burning wax, honest fragrance, and jars worth keeping. No synthetic dyes, no lead wicks, no shortcuts.

Why Our Candles Are Different

Natural Soy Wax

Grown and pressed in the USA, our soy wax burns cleaner and longer than paraffin.

Hand-Poured in Small Batches

Every jar is poured and inspected by hand, never mass-produced on an assembly line.

Reusable Glass Jars

Once the wax is spent, wash the jar and use it for herbs, brushes, or a bedside candy dish.

Visit or Get in Touch

Shop Details
